thread:
Ravi S.: Pitched a tiny "mini-card" on the route list today. Quick-save filters + pin routing hints. Want agreement on what gets persisted (sample, model, routing pref).

Ally H.: Prefer explicit sample_pct stored at save time. Otherwise views change unexpectedly when route defaults update.

Marco G.: Backend ok with adding sample_pct, model_id, routing_pref. Keep fields nullable to avoid breaking old rows. Add spec_version to detect new saves.

Ravi S.: UX: show "inherits route default" vs "pinned 1.5%" in the card. Also a small preview estimate (cheap) and an Update Preview button.

Ally H.: Don't block save on heavy calc. Do cheap estimate on save + background job for accurate tokens/hour. Show "preview stale" if >12h.

Marco G.: Migration plan: new saves write sample_pct = route default unless user opts out. Existing saves keep null. Admin job to materialize samples later.

infra-bot: feature-ops: created flag `console.mini_cards_v1` in LaunchDarkly. Default off. Use `/promote console.mini_cards_v1 XX%`.

Ravi S.: Proposed API payload (minimal):

```http
POST /api/v1/mini_views
{
  "route_id": "r-9",
  "model_id": "m-13b-q4",
  "routing_pref": "latency",
  "sample_pct": 1.5,
  "display_name": "Payments - retry errors",
  "spec_version": "1"
}
```

Marco G.: Add `display_context` (e.g., team tag) and `visibility` (team|org|private). Also `last_preview_at` to track TTL.

Ally H.: I'll draft microcopy for the pin modal and BETA badge. Ravi will add keyboard shortcut for quick-save.

Ravi S.: OK owners: Ravi (UX/front-end), Marco (schema+migration+preview worker), Ally (copy + docs). I'll open an issue and drop the mock. Thanks!
